COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Nurturing Empathy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Nurturing Empathy as rumours only.
   B. Say Nurturing Empathy never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Nurturing Empathy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Nurturing Empathy.

3. Which statement about Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr.
   C. Treat Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr as rumours only.
   D. Explain Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Civic Dialogue is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Civic Dialogue.
   B. Treat Civic Dialogue as rumours only.
   C. Explain Civic Dialogue with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Civic Dialogue never happens in Kenya.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

6. Which statement about Intercultural Competence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Intercultural Competence never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Intercultural Competence as rumours only.
   C. Explain Intercultural Competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Intercultural Competence.

7. Which statement about Leadership Development is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development.
   B. Treat Leadership Development as rumours only.
   C. Say Leadership Development never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea as rumours only.
   C. Explain Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea.

9. Which statement about Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im as rumours only.
   C. Explain Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im.

10. Which statement about Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte as rumours only.
   B. Say Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte.

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

12. Which statement about Negotiation Skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Negotiation Skills as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Negotiation Skills.
   C. Explain Negotiation Skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Negotiation Skills never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Building Consensus and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Problem Identification Process and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
